title: How to Create an Email List in Gmail (2026 Guide) | Scrap.io

facts.fact: According to the vendor (Scrap.io), there are 25,780,971 businesses on Google Maps in the US.
facts.quote: There are 25,780,971 businesses on Google Maps in the US right now.

facts.fact: According to the vendor (Scrap.io), 8,851,466 of the US businesses on Google Maps have a public email address that can be reached.
facts.quote: Only 8,851,466 of them have a public email address you can actually reach.

facts.fact: The vendor states that creating a contact-label email list in Google Contacts takes about four minutes.
facts.quote: It takes four minutes and it's free.

facts.fact: The vendor's comparison table gives a setup time of about 15 minutes for a Google Group.
facts.quote: Setup time | ~4 minutes | ~15 minutes | An afternoon

facts.fact: The vendor states that Google Groups is built for Google Workspace and that some of its nicer admin controls assume a paid plan.
facts.quote: Google Groups is really built for Google Workspace, and some of the nicer admin controls assume you're on a paid plan.

facts.fact: The vendor states that deleting a contact label removes the grouping (the list) but not the contacts themselves.
facts.quote: Deleting the label deletes the list, not the contacts.

facts.fact: The vendor states that when a label is placed in the Bcc field with your own address in To, replies come back only to the sender.
facts.quote: The catch? Replies come back only to you.

facts.fact: The vendor states that Google Contacts can import a CSV file, so spreadsheet data can be brought in without retyping.
facts.quote: Google Contacts imports a CSV.

facts.fact: A free Gmail account can reach 500 recipients in a rolling 24-hour window.
facts.quote: 500. That's how many recipients a free Gmail account can reach in 24 hours

facts.fact: Gmail's free-account sending limit counts recipients rather than messages, and the count is cumulative across To, Cc, and Bcc.
facts.quote: the count is cumulative across To, Cc, and Bcc — every field adds up

facts.fact: The Gmail sending quota is a rolling 24-hour window rather than a midnight reset.
facts.quote: It's a rolling 24-hour window, so if you send at 3pm today you can't send again to a fresh batch until 3pm tomorrow.

facts.fact: Google Workspace accounts can send 2,000 messages per day.
facts.quote: | Google Workspace | 2,000 | Up to 10,000 |

facts.fact: A list of 400 contacts in Bcc would consume 80% of a free Gmail account's daily recipient quota in a single send.
facts.quote: A list of 400 contacts sitting in Bcc? That's 80% of your daily free-Gmail quota gone in a single click.

facts.fact: Since 2024, Gmail, Yahoo and Microsoft have tightened sender requirements and now expect proper authentication before trusting mail.
facts.quote: Since 2024, Gmail, Yahoo and Microsoft have tightened the rules on who's even allowed into the inbox

facts.fact: As of August 8, 2026, Scrap.io (vendor data) counts 25,780,971 businesses referenced across the United States.
facts.quote: As of August 8, 2026, Scrap.io counts 25,780,971 businesses referenced across the United States

facts.fact: Per Scrap.io data as of August 8, 2026, 8,851,466 US businesses have a public email address, which is 34.3% of those referenced.
facts.quote: of which 8,851,466 have a public email address

facts.fact: Scrap.io's catalog covers 225,676,406 establishments across 195 countries.
facts.quote: the catalog runs to 225,676,406 establishments across 195 countries

facts.quote: Email marketing still returns $36 to $42 for every $1 spent — against roughly $2 for paid search

facts.fact: Per Marketful (2026), about 18% of businesses push past 7,000% ROI from email marketing.
facts.quote: About 18% of businesses push past 7,000% ROI, which is more than $70 back on the dollar (Marketful, 2026)

facts.quote: A B2B contact list loses about 2.1% of its accuracy every single month. Compound that and it's roughly 22.5% a year

facts.fact: Per Cleanlist (2026), somewhere between 15 and 20% of professionals change jobs every year.
facts.quote: Somewhere between 15 and 20% of professionals change jobs every year

facts.quote: That's why 50,000+ professionals re-extract instead of recycling old files

facts.quote: Under 50 recipients and no personalization, Gmail is fine.

facts.quote: Up to 500/day
